newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nomura Securities keeps falling in morning Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Nomura Securities keeps falling in morning Tokyo.

text.p: Nomura Securities Co Ltd shares kept tumbling in Friday morning trade, falling to a new low for the year, brokers said.

As of 0147 GMT, the shares were down 60 yen at 1,480 yen, in a turnover of 4.777 million, the fifth most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo exchange. Brokers said shares in the Japanese brokerage were hurt by the weakness in the overall stock market.
"Compared with bank shares, it seems the securities sector still has room to move downward and the shares are slipping," a broker at a medium-sized brokerage said.
